race.comment: COOL AS POPEYE (6) is knocking on the door. Has flashed home in her last two after settling in a different postcode to his rivals. The rise in trip suits and if Keatings can have her closer this time she will take plenty of holding out. PROPHET'S PROMISE (4) was a strong winner two back on the Acton before following it up with a solid effort at Albury. Has found form and finds a nice race to keep the ball rolling. HUSSY LA VISTA (7) made light work of her maiden rivals last time at the Sapphire Coast. Full of confidence now and is drawn to get all the favours. BELLA PIAZZA (1) arrived just in time to shed his maiden tag last start over the mile at Forbes. Will need to raise the bar again but gets the key booking of Loy. THE ARROW (10) hasn't been far away in her last two under RWK with the 2kg claim. Doesn't need to improve much to break through this time. KINDAMAGIC (8) is knocking on the door and should have enough speed to offset the wide draw. Not forgetting.
